extension.name: Markdown Reader
extension.description: Read Markdown in the current VS Code tab with a synchronized table of contents, syntax highlighting, diagrams, math and an English/Chinese UI.
setting.language.description: Language used by the reader interface.
setting.language.auto: Follow the VS Code display language.
setting.toc.enabled: Show the table of contents when opening a document.
setting.toc.maxDepth: Maximum heading depth shown in the table of contents.
setting.toc.width: Default table of contents width in pixels.
setting.theme.reader: Reader typography with a document-like layout.
setting.colorMode.description: Reader appearance. High contrast always follows the workbench.
setting.fontFamily.description: Body font family installed locally. Empty uses system fonts; code remains monospace.
setting.fontSize.description: Body font size in pixels. Headings scale proportionally.
setting.fontSizeMode.description: Follow the VS Code editor font size, or use markdownReader.fontSize.
setting.largeFile.mode.description: Large file mode shows code, math and diagrams as source, preserving navigation and search.
setting.largeFile.mode.auto: Enable at the configured file-size threshold.
setting.largeFile.thresholdKb.descriptio: Automatic large file mode threshold in KiB (UTF-8 bytes).
